page.overview:
Who is Dovos?

Dovos is a resident of Skyloft. He is a lover of food who sits at one of the tables in the during the day, awaiting Piper's food. After Link wins the Wing Ceremony, Dovos congratulates him and reminds the young hero that he can find relevant tips by pressing the Wii Remote's 2 Button. If Link sits at the same table Dovos is, he will tell Link that Piper's cooking is delicious but takes a long time to prepare. At night, Dovos can be found on the Lumpy Pumpkin's second floor.

Later, Dovos will tell Link of a rumor about a sobbing woman in the Knight Academy. If Link had already passed the restroom in the Knight Academy and heard Phoeni calling for paper from the bathroom, Dovos will sympathize and say that he has been in that situation before. After Link has seen the source of the sobbing, Dovos misinterprets it as someone's living hand reaching out of the bathroom stall for someone to hand them toilet paper, instead of a severed, ghostly hand.
